title: KYA-OS Handshake Response
description: Server response to a successful handshake request, establishing session context (SPEC.md §5.3). The server sends it as JSON text in the first content item of the handshake tool's result. A refusal is { success: false, protocolVersion, error } with isError set, and is not described here.

success.description: Set by the reference implementation, which also answers a refusal with success: false.

sessionId.description: Unique session identifier. A client names it on each tool call in params._meta["org.kya-os/session"] (SPEC.md §14).

serverDid.description: The server's DID used for proof verification.

serverKid.description: The verification method of serverDid the server signs its proofs with.

protocolVersion.description: The KYA-OS protocol version the server speaks, as MAJOR.MINOR (e.g., '1.0'; SPEC.md §13).

serverCapabilities.description: Server capability flags indicating supported features.

proofs.description: Server supports detached proofs on tool responses.

sessionTtl.description: Session time-to-live in seconds. Client SHOULD refresh before expiration.

nonce.description: Echo of the client's nonce for binding verification.
